title: MA and NY Rebate Deadlines for 2026: Nov 1, Nov 30, Dec 10, Dec 31
desc: Year-end rebate deadlines for Massachusetts and New York homeowners in 2026: EV charger rebates, heat pump water heater offers and the Mass Save heat pump filing date.
h1: Massachusetts and New York Rebate Deadlines for 2026
lead: Most Mass Save and NYS Clean Heat rebates keep running into 2027. A few do not. This page lists the ones with a date attached: EV charger rebates in Massachusetts, limited-time heat pump water heater offers in New York, and the filing date for 2026 Mass Save heat pumps. We checked the utilities' own pages on October 10, 2026.
sections:
Today is 22 days before November 1, 51 days before November 30, 61 days before December 10 and 82 days before December 31.

  • November 1, 2026: Eversource Massachusetts home EV charging rebate applications, with Managed Charging enrollment, must be in.
  • November 30, 2026: Con Edison's higher heat pump water heater rebate and the matching NYSEG and RG&E offer end.
  • December 10, 2026: National Grid Massachusetts EV charging upgrade work must be done and the application submitted.
  • December 31, 2026: Eversource's current EV program ends, and Orange & Rockland's water heater offer ends.
  • February 28, 2027: the apply-by date an archived Mass Save page lists for heat pumps installed in 2026.
Massachusetts: EV charger rebates are the ones with real cliffs

Eversource says its current Massachusetts EV charging rebate program ends on December 31, 2026, and that applications must be complete and include Managed Charging enrollment by November 1, 2026 to get a rebate. Rebates cover the wiring or panel work for a 240-volt outlet: up to $700 on the standard rate for one household, and up to $1,400 for a charger shared by households in a two-to-four unit building. Eversource says it is waiting for the state to approve a 2027 program and that installs finished after November 1 may be able to apply if one exists. That is not a promise, so do not count on it.

National Grid's page is stricter about timing. It says to complete eligible work and submit your application by December 10, 2026, and that applications after that date are not eligible. Its wiring rebate is up to $700 for a single-family home. You must also enroll in its Off-Peak Charging program, which pays about $100 a year, and National Grid says rebate checks take 6 to 8 weeks after enrollment is confirmed. It says incentives are expected to change in 2027.

If you are planning a charger, the order of work is: book the electrician, check your charger is on your utility's approved list, enroll in the utility's charging program, and file. Our Massachusetts EV charger page has the full amounts.

We could not re-read Mass Save's own site for this guide, because it blocks automated readers. An archived copy of its air-source heat pump page, saved on July 16, 2026, says installs done in 2026 must be applied for by February 28, 2027, and lists whole-home rebates of $2,650 per ton up to $8,500. Treat that as a lead, not a final answer: open masssave.com in your browser and confirm the date before you rely on it. The Mass Save plan itself covers 2025 through 2027, so there is no December 31 cliff for heat pumps that we can point to. Our Mass Save guide and Massachusetts hub list the rest.

One date is already behind us. The federal tax credits for heat pumps and other home upgrades (25C) and for solar (25D) ended for property placed in service after December 31, 2025, so there is no year-end federal credit rush in 2026.
New York: heat pump water heaters have a limited-time offer

The NYS Clean Heat program manual (version 3, effective September 1, 2026) sets a limited-time offer for heat pump water heaters. Con Edison raises its rebate from $1,300 to $1,500 for applications submitted from September 1 to November 30, 2026. That is the only one of the group where the homeowner's amount goes up.

NYSEG and RG&E run the same September 1 to November 30 window, but the manual keeps their base amount at $1,250 and raises only the payments to distributors ($300 instead of $150) and installers ($200 instead of $50). Orange & Rockland's offer runs September 15 to December 31, 2026, with the same kind of change: distributor $300 and installer $200, with the $1,250 amount unchanged. The extra payments go to the trade, which may or may not show up in your quote, so ask your installer.

The manual limits a household to one heat pump water heater rebate per account per calendar year, and sales of two or more to one address need pre-approval. For Con Edison, our Con Edison guide has the details.
New York: heat pump space heating has no year-end date

The manual's new higher amounts for weatherized homes began on September 1, 2026. We found no year-end cutoff for the main heat pump rebates, but the manual says utilities can change amounts, timing and caps at any time, and that your rebate is based on the rules in effect when you apply. If you have a contract in hand, apply sooner rather than later. See our NYS Clean Heat guide.

1. If you want an EV charger rebate, book the electrician now. November 1 (Eversource) and December 10 (National Grid) are the ones that can cost you the rebate.
  2. If you plan to replace a water heater in Con Edison territory, apply before November 30 to get $1,500 instead of $1,300.
  3. If you installed a heat pump in 2026 in Massachusetts, file your Mass Save application well before February 28, 2027. Do not wait for the last day.
  4. Keep invoices, model numbers and photos of the equipment. Each program asks for them.
faq: When does the Eversource Massachusetts EV charger rebate end?
Eversource says the current program ends on December 31, 2026. Applications must be complete, with Managed Charging enrollment, by November 1, 2026.
What is the National Grid Massachusetts EV charging deadline?
National Grid says to complete eligible work and submit your application by December 10, 2026. Applications after that date are not eligible, and it expects incentives to change in 2027.
When is the Mass Save heat pump deadline for 2026?
An archived Mass Save page from July 16, 2026 says to apply by February 28, 2027 for installs done in 2026. We could not re-read the live page, so confirm it on masssave.com.
Is the Con Edison heat pump water heater offer ending?
Yes. The $1,500 limited-time offer applies to applications submitted from September 1 to November 30, 2026. The regular rebate is $1,300.
Do the federal heat pump tax credits end this year?
They already ended. The 25C and 25D credits do not apply to property placed in service after December 31, 2025.
Will EV charger rebates return in 2027?
Both utilities say they expect changes in 2027. Eversource is waiting for state approval of a 2027 program. Neither has confirmed amounts.
